page_too_slow: page too slow: more than {seconds} s to read it
scheme_refused: address refused: only http and https pages can be read.
page_unreachable: page unreachable: connection failed or interrupted
search_too_slow: web search too slow: more than {seconds} s
search_error: the web search returned an error (HTTP {status})
search_unreachable: web search unreachable: connection failed or interrupted
blocked: address refused: not found or outside the public Internet (local network, this machine). Only a page requested on this machine can target its local network, by its IP address (http://192.168.1.20/…) or its local name (http://nas.local/…).
guard_bypassed: reading refused: the address guard does not apply with this version of requests or urllib3. Update AIODOS, or go back to the version of these packages it installs.
